projects.title: Late Contract Dashboard adds first-payment delays
projects.description: The Comptroller's office added a feature to its Late Contract Dashboard that tracks when the City issues first payments to vendors relative to the start of their contracts.
projects.why_interesting: Payment delays to nonprofits and vendors are a recurring accountability story, and this makes them trackable contract by contract.

projects.title: The 2026 NYC Co-op Carbon Cliff
projects.description: Borough Registry's data investigation of 18,878 residential properties under Local Law 97 estimates $460.9M in 2030 liabilities across 6,126 properties and looks at managing-firm concentration.
projects.why_interesting: A property-level look at who faces Local Law 97 fines, a story with direct reporting leads for co-op and condo boards.

projects.title: Walkipedia
projects.description: Pins every Wikipedia article within a short walk on a map; search a place or share your location.
projects.why_interesting: A simple, playful way to surface neighborhood history and trivia that works for any block in the city.

projects.title: OpenSidewalks: Sidewalks of the United States
projects.description: A pedestrian network for the whole country built by merging official city, county and state sidewalk datasets with OpenStreetMap.
projects.why_interesting: Sidewalk data is scarce; a merged national network is a model for walkability and accessibility analysis.

projects.title: AdaptBase climate adaptation knowledge base
projects.description: A climate adaptation knowledge base of urban resilience research from Cornell Tech.
projects.why_interesting: A searchable research library for resilience reporting, from a New York institution.

projects.title: NYC Capital Projects MCP server
projects.description: An MCP server over NYC Open Data's Capital Projects Dashboard: four Socrata datasets in a local DuckDB with 16 tools that build in the domain rules.
projects.why_interesting: Lets an AI assistant query city capital project data without tripping on its quirks.

projects.title: New Orleans Health Atlas
projects.description: Launched Nov. 17, the free tool breaks down nearly 150 health topics by age, gender, ethnicity and neighborhood, alongside the city's Community Health Assessment.
projects.why_interesting: A neighborhood-level health data layout other cities could copy.

projects.title: Raleigh Housing Production Dashboard
projects.description: Updated Nov. 16 with first-quarter fiscal 2027 data, the interactive map shows housing developments with transit routes, council districts and housing costs.
projects.why_interesting: Pairs housing production with transit and council districts in one public view.

projects.title: Mapping missing-middle housing in Chicago from street imagery
projects.description: Yale researchers used AI on street-level imagery to map duplexes, townhouses and small apartment buildings, finding much of it in areas where zoning no longer allows it.
projects.why_interesting: A replicable method for measuring housing that official records miss, relevant to New York's zoning debates.

projects.title: Mapping Displacement Pressure in Chicago, 2026
projects.description: DePaul's Institute for Housing Studies interactive tool sorts neighborhoods by housing market type and resident vulnerability to displacement.
projects.why_interesting: A combined market and vulnerability typology that could be applied to New York neighborhoods.
